subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.chooseSubtitle: Customers use Buurklus for free. You only pay to receive the jobs.
subscription.vatNotice: Prices exclude VAT. 21% Dutch VAT is added at invoicing.
subscription.trialBody: {{credits}} free quotes, no payment details needed.
subscription.cancelConfirm: You keep access until the end of the paid period.
subscription.outOfCreditsBody: You have used all of this month’s quotes. Your allowance is topped up again at the start of your next month.

free.title: Buurklus costs you nothing for the time being
free.body: We have just started and want enough jobs in every municipality first. Until then you pay nothing: no subscription, no commission and no payment details.
free.later: Buurklus will cost money one day. When it does you will hear at least {{days}} days in advance, by email and in the app. Nothing is ever charged automatically: without your agreement your account stays free.
free.noPayment: There is no payment method on your account, and we do not ask for one.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: What we keep about you, for how long, and what you can do with it.
privacy.exportBody: A file with everything we hold about you.
privacy.exportFailed: The download failed. Please try again later.
privacy.marketingBody: Tips and news about Buurklus. Off unless you turn it on, and you can turn it off again without losing your account.
privacy.deleteBody: Your data is erased. Your jobs and reviews stay, without your name. Invoices are kept for seven years, which Dutch tax law requires.
